title: Recipe for apple-agar embryo collection plates
author: Katy M Monteith
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.p4ndqve
materials: Dispense apple-agar into plates before it sets.

steps.title: Prepare agar and sucrose mixture
steps.instruction: Combine agar, sucrose, and distilled water in a pan.

substeps.instruction: Add 9 g of agar to 300 mL distilled H₂O
Add 10 g sucrose to the mixture

steps.title: Boil the mixture
steps.instruction: Heat the mixture to boiling while stirring continuously.

steps.title: Add apple juice
steps.instruction: Turn off the heat once boiling and add 100 mL apple juice to the mixture.

steps.title: Add anti-fungal solution
steps.instruction: Cool the mixture to approximately 70 °C and stir in tegosept anti-fungal solution.

substeps.instruction: Stir in 2.1 mL of tegosept anti-fungal solution (Methyl-4-hydroxybenzoate dissolved in 95% Ethanol at 150g/L)
